name: Palo Brunch Traditional Italian Marsala Zabaglione with Biscotti
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Warm whipped egg-yolk and sweet Marsala wine custard is cloud-light and zero-fiber; only the fresh berry base and almond biscotti carry roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the whipped Marsala Zabaglione custard served in a coupe glass without the seeded raspberries/blackberries, and skip the whole-almond biscotti.
watchOuts: Seeded fresh berries at the bottom of the glass
